item.title: Democrats Counter With STEAL Act To Ban Voter ID
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. — With debate ongoing over the Republican-proposed SAVE Act to shore up U.S. election integrity, Democrat lawmakers countered by proposing their own legislation, the STEAL Act, to ban voter ID in elections.

item.title: Fraud Suspicions Arise As Somali Team Wins 734th Gold Medal At Winter Olympics
item.description: MILAN — Somalia's Olympic delegation raised eyebrows and suspicions of fraud this week after winning the country's 734th gold medal at the 2026 Milano Cortina Winter Olympics.

item.title: Kid Rock's 'Bawitdaba' Added To Hymnals
item.description: U.S. — Following his inspiring appearance at TPUSA's All-American Halftime Show and increased popularity among Christian conservatives, musician Kid Rock was notified that his 1999 hit song "Bawitdaba" would be added to hymnals in churches across the country.

item.title: Bible Authors Admit They Were Paid $7K For Every Reference To Israel
item.description: HEAVEN — In a shocking revelation that falls in line with a common suspicion online over the last year, several of the men who authored books of the Bible finally admitted that they were all paid $7,000 for every reference they made to Israel.

item.title: Elon Confirms Mars Voyage Delayed Again After 'Diablo II' Update
item.description: AUSTIN, TX — Humanity's voyage to Mars suffered a significant delay following an admission by SpaceX CEO Elon Musk that he just learned of a new update to Diablo II: Resurrected, and he would be quite busy playing that for the next few years.

item.title: Trump Orders Drone Strike On Venezuelan Olympic Cross-Country Skier
item.description: TESERO — Venezuelan cross-country skier Nicolas Claveau-Laviolette was blown off the course on Thursday in what appeared to be a drone strike conducted by the United States military at the direct order of President Donald Trump.

item.title: 'Gunperson' And 7 Other More Inclusive Terms To Use For Non-Binary Criminals
item.description: When reporting on crime, it's of paramount importance that journalists adhere to a strict code of ethics, which involves using AP-approved inclusionary terms to identify assailants of indeterminate gender. For example, if a person shoots and kills someone, and you can't readily discern their gender, try identifying them as the most inclusive "gunperson."
